notes: Two Treasures, two colours on one board: one pays Portcullis Vine's {G}, the other Shock's {R}. Mana abilities are no menu rows (2026-11-11): the payer sacrifices a Treasure while a cost is paid, choosing its colour (CR 605.3a), so the pack casts with "tap": true. Each spell is payable only by a Treasure making its colour, so both resolve only when the payer picks green, then red. A sacrificed Treasure is a token that left the battlefield, so it ceases to exist (CR 704.5d): its zone is 'ceased'.
